verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's Scheduled Tasks feature explicitly supports recurring background automations and event-triggered runs (Gmail, Slack, GitHub) without manual polling, plus a dashboard to review active/paused/completed runs. This directly matches the story of autonomous background automations, though evidence is entirely first-party docs with no independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of reliability and any failure-mode reports for scheduled/event-triggered automations.
